implementation_or_event_clock.description: A source whose relevance moves with implementation, guidance cycles, or events.

live_or_current_surface.description: A live dashboard, current program page, or frequently changing public surface.

periodic_refresh.description: A source updated on a periodic, annual, revision, or report cycle.

stable_or_historical_anchor.description: A stable legal, historical, report, or slow-changing anchor.

supersession_or_policy_clock.description: A source vulnerable to policy replacement, litigation movement, or explicit supersession.

unclassified_or_other.description: Fallback category for blank, unclassified, or other named clocks.

checked_or_current.description: The source has a current, checked, or resolved retrieval posture but may still have ordinary evidence limits.

limited_reliance.description: The source can be used only with explicit limits; it does not prove the full claim or outcome.

needs_followup_or_check.description: The source needs a follow-up check, capture, direct review, or unresolved route verification.

stable_or_historical_anchor.description: The source is a stable report, legal anchor, historical page, or archived/historical surface.

unclassified_or_other.description: Fallback category for blank, unclassified, or otherwise uncategorized labels.

taxonomy_role: Editable alias map for source-health normalization; preserves raw ledger labels while moving comparison rules out of build_source_health.py.
